dependency_findings.dev_dependency_shape: same rmcp package under [dev-dependencies] with client transport features; Cargo rejected a renamed direct rmcp 1.7 dev-dependency because the package was already depended on under name rmcp.
dependency_findings.stack_note: Debug BioMCP child processes needed RUST_MIN_STACK=8388608 during tests; without it initial prototype saw stack overflow in tokio worker threads.
